items.titolo: Google Gemini 4 Carbon disponibile per tutti

items.titolo: Lawyer builds private AI server with eight used Nvidia V100 GPUs
items.descrizione: A lawyer runs DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on eight used 2018-era Nvidia V100 GPUs at up to 215 tokens/s, keeping case files in the office.
